# `intelligent_route`

Select an upstream cluster for an inference model or MCP tool from a validated
routing snapshot. Place this filter after request classification and before
`load_balancer`.

The configuration producer owns candidate ordering, priority groups, admission,
and any geography or load scoring. `intelligent_route` consumes those decisions;
it does not scrape metrics, query a controller, or recompute scores while handling
a request. Praxis AI registers this filter; Praxis core supplies the filter
runtime and upstream transport.

## Request flow

```text
Request body / MCP message
            |
   Model extraction / MCP classification
            |
   intelligent_route
     1. Bypass management paths or preserve an existing cluster
     2. Resolve the model or tool
     3. Reuse an eligible session binding, if present
     4. Select from the first eligible producer-defined group
     5. Set the upstream cluster and routing metadata
            |
   Optional credential / provider transformation filters
            |
       load_balancer
            |
   Backend or authenticated provider gateway
```

The filter selects a cluster, not an endpoint within that cluster. Configure
upstream addresses, TLS, connection handling, and endpoint selection in the
downstream `load_balancer`.

## Configuration sources

Choose exactly one source:

| Source | Routing data | Updates | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Static | Inline `candidates` and `local_site` | Pipeline reload | Nonempty candidates; deterministic selection; no traffic weights |
| Versioned overlay | Content-addressed `routing-overlay.json` envelope | Atomic snapshot reload | Integrity and optional scope validation; supports groups, selection policies, and authoritative empty snapshots |
| Legacy overlay | Flat `routing-config.json` payload | Atomic snapshot reload | Nonempty candidates; no provider profiles; cannot satisfy `expected_overlay_scope` |

Use a versioned envelope for controller-managed deployments. Legacy payloads
remain available for compatibility.

### Static configuration

This complete configuration routes the body model `example-model` to the first
matching candidate. The second candidate is not selected merely because it is
local or has a different `fresh` value.

```yaml
listeners:
  - name: inference
    address: "0.0.0.0:8080"
    filter_chains: [inference]

filter_chains:
  - name: inference
    filters:
      - filter: model_to_header
        header: X-Model
      - filter: intelligent_route
        local_site: site-a
        model_header: X-Model
        clusters: [primary, secondary]
        candidates:
          - kind: inference_model
            name: example-model
            site: site-b
            cluster: primary
          - kind: inference_model
            name: example-model
            site: site-a
            cluster: secondary
      - filter: load_balancer
        clusters:
          - name: primary
            endpoints: ["127.0.0.1:8001"]
          - name: secondary
            endpoints: ["127.0.0.1:8002"]

insecure_options:
  allow_private_endpoints: true # Local example backends only.
```

`model_to_header` derives the model from the request body and removes a
client-supplied copy of its configured header. `intelligent_route` itself reads
the promoted header; it does not parse the body. See [model extraction].

### Overlay configuration

Replace the static routing filter with:

```yaml
filter: intelligent_route
model_header: X-Model
overlay_file: /etc/praxis/routing/routing-overlay.json
clusters: [primary, secondary]
expected_overlay_scope:
  network: inference-grid
  gateway: consumer
  namespace: grid-system
  local_site: site-a
reload:
  enabled: true
  debounce_ms: 500
```

Declare every possible selected cluster in the downstream load balancer. With
`clusters` set, the list is authoritative: pipeline validation checks its names
against the load balancer, and initial or replacement snapshots referencing any
other cluster are rejected. Without this list, overlay candidates are not
reported to pipeline cluster validation and replacement snapshots are not checked
against the upstream inventory; selection can then fail downstream for an unknown
cluster. Static candidates are reported when no explicit list is supplied.
`management_cluster` is always reported.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `candidates` | CandidateConfig[] | no | Static list of route candidates (mutually exclusive with `overlay_file`). |
| `candidates[].cluster` | string | yes | Cluster name to select when this candidate is chosen. |
| `candidates[].provider` | string | no | Optional provider marker for provider-specific downstream filters. |
| `candidates[].target_model` | string | no | Optional provider-specific model identifier written to the request body after this candidate is selected. |
| `candidates[].paths` | string[] | no | Optional request paths on which `target_model` is applied. |
| `candidates[].catalog` | string[] | no | Discovery envelopes in which this candidate is advertised. |
| `candidates[].display_name` | string | no | Optional discovery display name. |
| `candidates[].owned_by` | string | no | Optional discovery owner label. |
| `candidates[].created` | integer | no | Optional discovery creation timestamp. |
| `candidates[].credential` | CandidateCredential | no | Optional final-hop credential reference. |
| `candidates[].credential.strategy` | string | yes | Injection strategy. |
| `candidates[].credential.secretRef` | CredentialRef | yes | Secret locator, never secret bytes. |
| `candidates[].credential.secretRef.key` | string | yes | Secret data key. |
| `candidates[].credential.secretRef.name` | string | yes | Secret name. |
| `candidates[].credential.secretRef.namespace` | string | yes | Secret namespace. |
| `candidates[].fresh` | bool | no | Whether this candidate is fresh (default: `true`). |
| `candidates[].kind` | `inference_model` \| `mcp_tool` | yes | Capability kind. |
| `candidates[].name` | string | yes | Capability name (model name, tool name, or agent name). |
| `candidates[].site` | string | yes | Site that owns this capability. |
| `candidates[].traffic_weight` | integer | no | Optional weight for an overlay using `selection_policy.mode: weightedRandom`. Inline static candidates cannot use traffic weights. |
| `local_site` | string | no | Name of the local site (required in static mode, provided by overlay in overlay mode). |
| `model_header` | string | no | Header name that carries the model name (default: `X-Model`). |
| `body_authoritative` | bool | no | Resolve inference model routing from the request body during the body phase. This prevents a client-supplied model header from selecting a backend before `model_to_header` has inspected the body. |
| `skip_paths` | string[] | no | Request-path prefixes that bypass model resolution entirely. Management and discovery endpoints (model listing, subscriptions, API-key management, health) carry no routable model; a matching request returns `Continue` before any model lookup. Defaults to the well-known OpenAI-style management paths; set an explicit list to override, or `[]` to disable path skipping. See `path_is_management` for the match rule. |
| `management_cluster` | string | no | Cluster that serves skipped management/discovery paths. When set, a request whose path matches `skip_paths` has `ctx.cluster` set to this cluster and continues straight to `load_balancer`. When unset, skipped paths continue with the cluster untouched. Requires a non-empty `skip_paths`. |
| `provider_hop_clusters` | string[] | no | Clusters that terminate the authenticated provider-hop protocol. A selected candidate emits the fixed routing context only when its cluster is present in this allowlist. Each named cluster must use an mTLS-authenticated Praxis provider gateway. Direct API/backend clusters remain absent. |
| `expected_overlay_scope` | ExpectedOverlayScope | no | Expected scope of the overlay envelope. When set, each specified field is validated against the envelope scope on load and every reload. Rejected on mismatch. Only relevant in overlay mode with envelope-format files. |
| `expected_overlay_scope.network` | string | no | Expected network name. |
| `expected_overlay_scope.gateway` | string | no | Expected gateway name. |
| `expected_overlay_scope.namespace` | string | no | Expected namespace. |
| `expected_overlay_scope.local_site` | string | no | Expected local site. |
| `overlay_file` | PathBuf | no | Path to a routing overlay JSON file (`routing-overlay.json` envelope or legacy `routing-config.json`). When set, candidates and `local_site` are read from the overlay instead of the YAML config. |
| `reload` | ReloadConfig | no | Hot reload configuration for overlay mode. Only valid when `overlay_file` is set.  Providing a `reload:` block with static `candidates` is rejected — static candidates are immutable for the lifetime of the filter. |
| `reload.enabled` | bool | no | Whether file watching is enabled (default: `true`). |
| `reload.debounce_ms` | integer | no | Debounce window in milliseconds (default: 500). |
| `session_affinity` | SessionAffinityConfig | no | Session affinity configuration (disabled by default). |
| `session_affinity.cookie` | string | no | Name of a cookie to extract the session key from. |
| `session_affinity.enabled` | bool | no | Whether session affinity is enabled (default: `false`). |
| `session_affinity.header` | string | no | Header name to extract the session key from. |
| `session_affinity.ttl_secs` | integer | no | Binding TTL in seconds (default: 3600, max: 86400). |
